title: Chain Covers in the Boolean Lattice
summary: For integers $1\le r\le n+1$, let $N(n,r)$ denote the least number of chains in the Boolean lattice $B_n=2^{[n]}$ that cover every strict $r$-term chain. The case $r=1$ is the classical chain-decomposition problem and is generalizing Dilworth's theorem and Sperner's theorem. We study two complementary regimes.
